Bug_Title: "volatile" variables should not be used with compound operators
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by using compound operators (increment and toggle) on volatile primitive fields (count and boo). These operations are not atomic, which can lead to data loss if threads interleave in the steps of the update.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when multiple threads increment the volatile int count simultaneously. This can lead to data loss as the increment operation is not atomic.
